name: @w6w-apps/jev
description: Evaluate state against typed questions with TypeSafe's System One (Jev).

w6w.longDescription:
Jev is TypeSafe's System One evaluation API. A workflow hands it a description of some state plus a map of typed questions, and gets back one typed answer per question — a structured verdict rather than free-form chat.

The app lists the models available to the API key and runs evaluations against any of them, so the model choice stays explicit in the workflow.

A fit for classification, validation and decision steps where a downstream step needs a typed answer it can branch on.
